brief.objective: Produce the minimum safe implementation. Reuse existing code whenever possible.

instruction:
MISSION: FLEET_BRIDGE_V1

OBJECTIVE:
Produce only a Patch Plan for the missing ODG ↔ Claude Code bridge.

Do NOT implement anything.

The bridge must:
- monitor runtime/generated/fleet/requests/
- detect new request JSON files
- invoke Claude Code
- receive a structured JSON response
- write the response into runtime/generated/fleet/responses/
- prevent duplicate processing
- handle timeouts and failures safely
- preserve current Runtime behavior when disabled
